Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental logical error in the final conclusion. After correctly gathering the birth dates (José Echegaray y Eizaguirre: 1832 and P. J. O'Rourke: 1947), the Planner concluded that "P. J. O'Rourke was born first." This is incorrect because 1832 is earlier than 1947. The Planner failed to perform the basic chronological comparison of the two dates, leading to a wrong answer to the real-world problem.
